data.one_liner: Render LaTeX math formulas, inline math, and Markdown with math in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets like Math.tex and MathText to parse and render LaTeX mathematics natively in Flutter. It supports text wrapping, text selection, screen readers, custom themes, and streaming output for LLM responses.
use_when: You need to display mathematical formulas or equations in a Flutter app
You are building an LLM chat interface that streams LaTeX math content
You need inline math within standard text or Markdown
avoid_when: You do not need to display any mathematical notation or LaTeX
strengths: Native Flutter rendering without WebViews or external platform code
Supports formula wrapping, selection, and screen readers
Handles streaming input efficiently for LLM outputs
weaknesses: Limited to rendering LaTeX formulas and text integration
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.
